name: Моноусилитель мощности Emotiva XPA-HC1
descriptionHtml:
Моноусилитель мощности Emotiva XPA-HC1 — Single-channel high-current monoblock power amplifier using a discrete Class A/B stage, Optimized Class H power supply topology and high-efficiency SMPS. Характеристики ниже — только с страницы/листа производителя.

  • Power output: 300 W RMS at 8 ohms; 600 W RMS at 4 ohms
  • Rated bandwidth: 20 Hz–20 kHz
  • Broadband frequency response: 5 Hz–80 kHz, +0/−2 dB
  • THD + noise: <0.015% at 100 W RMS, 1 kHz, 8 ohms
  • >120 dB ref. FTC rated power, unbalanced input (A-weighted)

Характеристики производителя

Power output: 300 W RMS at 8 ohms; 600 W RMS at 4 ohms · Rated bandwidth: 20 Hz–20 kHz · Broadband frequency response: 5 Hz–80 kHz, +0/−2 dB · THD + noise: <0.015% at 100 W RMS, 1 kHz, 8 ohms · Signal-to-noise ratio: >120 dB ref. FTC rated power, unbalanced input (A-weighted) · Minimum recommended load: 4 ohms.

Provides selectable balanced XLR and unbalanced RCA inputs, trigger input/output, gold-plated five-way binding posts and microprocessor-controlled protection.
